lines.text: Your alarm asks one thing of you this morning.
A smile. And the bell lets go.
Your practice is here whenever you want it.
Your breath. Then your pulse. And a month of your own mornings.

bgm.query: quiet ambient dawn, no percussion, enters under Frame 2 and never competes with the voice
bgm.blob: The alarm asks for one smile. The practice waits until you want it.
bgm.arc: Future Pacing — imagine → name it → the mechanism → the offer → what it keeps → CTA
